stories.title: Elon Musk’s xAI used child porn to train Grok models, lawsuit says
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: xAI is accused in a lawsuit of using child pornography to train its Grok language models.
The allegations involve both real and AI-generated child pornography data.
This represents a severe ethical and safety breach concerning large language model training data.

stories.title: Report: Nvidia to acquire AI model repository Hugging Face for $13 billion
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: Nvidia is reportedly acquiring Hugging Face, a key repository for open AI models.
The acquisition is valued at an estimated $13 billion.
This move signifies Nvidia's strategic push to control critical infrastructure within the growing AI ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
Indicates the model is suitable for text generation tasks.
Categorizes the model under key AI/ML technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Anthropic's new hardware standard lets AI agents control the physical world
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: Anthropic is introducing a new hardware standard for AI agents.
This standard aims to enable AI systems to directly control physical devices.
The core concept is a standardized driver interface allowing devices and AIs to communicate.

stories.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable
stories.author: Pranav Aggarwal
bullet_points: LLM agents exhibit a strong tendency to commit to answers when presented with professional-looking, yet potentially fabricated, evidence.
The commitment to making a directional call on unpredictable questions increases dramatically (from 6.5% to 54.0%) when the model is shown a market panel.
Even when all data on the panel is entirely invented, the presence of the fabricated evidence still significantly increases the model's tendency to commit to a conclusion.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the DeepSeek-R1 model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation tasks, indicating its primary function.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors, suggesting integration into existing AI workflows.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key NLP/ML tags including 'transformers' and 'text-generation'.
This indicates continued community interest and benchmarking activity around Meta's latest LLM releases.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model designed specifically for persistent AI agents.
The model excels at multi-step tasks, context gathering, and tool calling on local hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 when running on Apple Silicon.
The speed improvement is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Performance gains reach up to 90% faster when integrated with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model designed for advanced AI tasks.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning capabilities.
It is optimized to support complex, long-running agent workflows in AI applications.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes a 'local-first' approach, allowing AI to run entirely on user hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating the use of local LLMs.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon, enhancing local AI inference speed on Apple hardware.
The feature is currently available in a preview build, indicating ongoing development and adoption.

stories.title: Google’s AI note-taking app now allows you to interact with books
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Google's Gemini Notebook now integrates with Google Play Books.
The new 'Expert Intelligence' feature allows users to query book content directly.
Users can generate diverse outputs like plans, infographics, and AI podcasts from book material.

stories.title: Google tells Android app developers to cool it on memory use, or else
stories.author: Allison Johnson
bullet_points: Google is implementing stricter memory usage policies for Android app developers.
This action is a direct response to growing industry-wide RAM constraints.
The Play Store will enforce these new memory usage limits on applications.

stories.title: Gating Before Commitment: Anticipating Intent Divergence to Prevent Post-Interaction Decision Failures in Autonomous Driving
stories.author: Ravi Sankar
bullet_points: Proposes a novel 'gating' decision layer to prevent autonomous driving planning failures caused by intent misinterpretation.
The system uses a language-guided intent module to compute a smoothed intent-geometry divergence score before committing to a maneuver.
Experimental results show this gating mechanism is critical for repairing plans in challenging scenarios like off-road departures and crashes.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run and utilize open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI interfaces with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving support on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Meta addresses ‘pervert glasses’ reputation with a privacy fix and a new marketing campaign
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Meta is addressing privacy concerns surrounding its AI smart glasses.
A software fix has been implemented to prevent unauthorized recording after the front-facing LED is covered.
The update ensures the camera will cease recording if the light sensor is obstructed during use.

stories.title: Sony finally has a cheaper OLED to compete with midrange Samsung and LG TVs
stories.author: John.Higgins
bullet_points: Sony has released the Bravia 6 OLED TV, positioning it as a more budget-friendly option.
This new model aims to compete in the mid-range television market against Samsung and LG.
The Bravia 6 is positioned below Sony's higher-tier OLED models like the Bravia 8 and Bravia 9 II.

stories.title: AI industry says Trump plans to tax chips in the “single dumbest way imaginable”
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: The AI industry is reacting negatively to proposed policies from Donald Trump.
The core of the concern is a plan to tax data centers as a strategy for the AI race.
Industry experts are characterizing the proposed taxation method as highly detrimental or illogical.

stories.title: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
stories.author: Zhongang Cai
bullet_points: Introduces VBVR-Pro, a new closed-loop testbed designed to advance native visual reasoning.
Addresses the current bottleneck in visual reasoning: the lack of scalable training tasks and reliable feedback mechanisms.
Proposes treating visual states (images/videos) as primary substrates for problem-solving, rather than just inputs or outputs.

stories.title: A Visual Dependence-Aware Framework for Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training
stories.author: Changsheng Xu
bullet_points: Introduces Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training (MU-CPT) for evolving deployed Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) using streaming unlabeled data.
Addresses a limitation in existing methods by focusing on heterogeneous visual dependence (VD) of tokens, rather than uniform optimization.
Proposes that structural distortion at the token level serves as a key indicator for detecting cross-modal catastrophic forgetting.

stories.title: MyoMechanix: Biomechanically-Grounded Compositional Skilled Activity Understanding and Coaching
stories.author: Weiwei Fu
bullet_points: Introduces MyoMechanix, a multimodal ecosystem designed for weight-loaded action analysis.
Addresses a gap in current Action Quality Assessment (AQA) by incorporating physiological dynamics (muscle mechanics) alongside visual data.
Features a substantial, expert-annotated dataset of 7,500+ samples across 20 actions from 38 subjects.

stories.title: Finding and using interpretable latents in a neutrino foundation model with sparse autoencoders
stories.author: Vincenzo Piuri
bullet_points: Applies sparse-autoencoder-based mechanistic interpretability to particle physics for the first time.
Analyzes a neutrino foundation model trained on IceCube data to understand its internal representations.
Successfully identified and validated an atlas of physical concepts within the model using rigorous testing protocols.

stories.title: Planetary Prediction Engine: Autonomous Geospatial Prediction via Intelligent Data Selection and Foundation Model Embeddings
stories.author: Shravya Shetty
bullet_points: Introduces the Planetary Prediction Engine (PPE), an autonomous AI system designed for high-fidelity geospatial modeling.
Aims to solve global challenges (food security, disaster risk, disease outbreaks) by overcoming data fragmentation.
The PPE automates the complex workflow of data retrieval, multimodal curation, fusion, and model selection.

stories.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development
stories.author: Yiming Yang
bullet_points: LLMs struggle with autonomous ML development, unlike isolated coding tasks.
Current outcome-based benchmarks fail to capture the weaknesses in the iterative development process.
TraceML is introduced to empirically analyze the interaction and limitations of human-agent planning in ML workflows.

stories.title: ICON Decomposition: Multivariate Concept-Level Explanations of Deep Representations for Model Auditing
stories.author: Kerstin Ritter
bullet_points: Introduces ICON decomposition, a new method to improve model auditing in deep neural networks.
Addresses a limitation in existing concept-based explainability methods where isolated concept testing can misinterpret correlations.
Aims to quantify the true contribution of multiple concepts simultaneously to prevent models from relying on spurious associations (shortcut learning).

stories.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents
stories.author: Markus J. Buehler
bullet_points: Introduces SwarmWorld, a framework for studying collective intelligence using language-model agents.
Challenges existing multi-agent system paradigms that rely on direct communication or centralized control.
Investigates the potential for decentralized LLM agents to autonomously build functional technologies.

stories.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
stories.author: Mike Lewis
bullet_points: The paper addresses the computational cost of test-time scaling in large language models (LLMs) due to retaining full reasoning traces.
It observes that intermediate reasoning tokens often lose importance as the model continues to process information.
The proposed solution, 'Prefix Sliding,' aims to efficiently manage this reasoning process to reduce computational overhead.

stories.title: TraceBench: Controlled Evaluation of LLM Agents for Time-Series Root-Cause Attribution
stories.author: Christian Holz
bullet_points: Introduces TraceBench, a simulation-based framework for evaluating LLM agents.
Focuses on controlled root-cause attribution tasks for time-series anomaly detection.
Addresses the lack of systematic evaluation for LLM performance in real-world system diagnostics.

stories.title: When Text Misleads: Inconsistent-Aware Reasoning for Audio-Grounded Dialogue
stories.author: Jesus Villalba
bullet_points: The research addresses a critical gap in audio-grounded dialogue systems: the reliance on transcripts that can mislead models.
It introduces the concept of 'cross-modal disagreement' to formally capture when lexical content conflicts with acoustic cues (like emotion or prosody).
The work pushes for more rigorous evaluation methods that force models to genuinely integrate both textual and paralinguistic speech signals.

stories.title: Data-efficient crack quantification in lithium-ion cathodes using foundation model transfer
stories.author: Weihan Li
bullet_points: Addresses a critical bottleneck in battery research: the difficulty and high cost of quantifying particle cracking in lithium-ion cathodes.
Proposes a data-efficient solution using a frozen self-supervised vision-transformer encoder combined with a lightweight decoder.
The methodology aims to automate pixel-level expert labeling for high-resolution electron microscopy data, accelerating battery degradation studies.

stories.title: Diffusion Policies for Short-Horizon Planning in Robot Crowd Navigation
stories.author: Jochen Garcke
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of safe and efficient decision-making in dense, dynamic robot crowd navigation.
Proposes Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization (PDPO), an offline-to-online RL framework.
Uses a diffusion policy to generate short-horizon action chunks, overcoming the limitations of single-timestep reactive actions.

stories.title: Over-The-Air Extreme Learning Machines with Nonlinear Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces
stories.author: George C. Alexandropoulos
bullet_points: Proposes an Over-The-Air (OTA) communication paradigm where machine learning inference is performed directly on wirelessly transferred data.
Utilizes an eXtremely Large (XL) Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) system configured as an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) for binary classification.
Reduces hardware complexity by employing cascaded metasurfaces terminating in a single radio-frequency chain at the receiver.

stories.title: When Text Misleads: Inconsistent-Aware Reasoning for Audio-Grounded Dialogue
stories.author: Jesus Villalba
bullet_points: The research addresses the limitation of current dialogue models that rely too heavily on text transcripts.
It introduces the concept of 'cross-modal disagreement,' where text and acoustic signals conflict.
The work proposes a method for 'Inconsistent-Aware Reasoning' to ensure models genuinely ground predictions in full speech context (lexical + paralinguistic).

stories.title: Prediction of Prediction (PoP): Inter-Layer Activation Fusion for Single-Pass Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
stories.author: Himal Badu
bullet_points: Addresses the critical issue of LLM hallucination, where models generate false information with high confidence.
Proposes 'Prediction of Prediction (PoP),' a method to detect factual errors by analyzing internal hidden-state transitions during generation.
Aims to provide a single-pass, low-overhead solution, bypassing the latency and memory costs of traditional multi-sample verification.

stories.title: STAR : Sentence Translation Alignment Rate for Document-to-Document Machine Translation
stories.author: Weihua Luo
bullet_points: The research addresses a key limitation in modern Doc2Doc Machine Translation (MT) enabled by LLMs: structural misalignment.
The problem manifests as sentence omissions or hallucinations, violating the necessary source-target correspondence.
A new auxiliary metric, STAR (Sentence Translation Alignment Rate), is introduced to explicitly measure and address this alignment issue.

stories.title: Said Aloud, Read Different: Cross-Modal Instability in Multimodal Models
stories.author: Nadir Durrani
bullet_points: Investigates cross-modal instability in multimodal foundation models, specifically comparing text vs. speech inputs.
Addresses the lack of consistency when semantically equivalent queries are presented in different modalities or languages (e.g., English vs. Arabic).
Introduces a large-scale, culturally grounded benchmark spanning 10,150 images from 18 MENA countries to test model robustness.

stories.title: TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy
stories.author: Xuming Hu
bullet_points: Addresses the memory bottleneck of KV cache in long-context LLM inference, particularly for resource-constrained models.
Challenges existing KV cache eviction heuristics (like attention magnitude) by showing it is uncorrelated with causal contribution.
Introduces 'TwinKV,' a new method leveraging pairwise key redundancy for more effective cache repair and eviction.

stories.title: Cross-Lingual Alignment Without Joint Training: Do Monolingual Language Models Converge on Universal Representations?
stories.author: Anna Korhonen
bullet_points: Investigates if monolingual language models can achieve cross-lingual alignment without requiring joint training.
Challenges the conventional assumption that cross-lingual alignment necessitates shared parameters or mixed-language training.
Tests findings using strictly monolingual models (e.g., Goldfish families) to assess the potential for universal representations.

stories.title: DocTalkBN: A Novel Dataset of Expert Telemedicine Conversations in Bengali
stories.author: Rifat Shahriyar
bullet_points: Introduces DocTalkBN, a large-scale, multimodal dataset of real-world telemedicine conversations.
Addresses the scarcity of authentic expert-patient interaction data for low-resource languages like Bengali.
The dataset comprises over 557 hours of paired audio and text from nationally broadcast medical programs.

stories.title: Unifying Detection and Adaptation in Task-Free Continual Learning
stories.author: Shuaishuai Guo
bullet_points: Addresses catastrophic forgetting in Large Language Models (LLMs) during continual learning.
Proposes a novel framework, FiUni, to unify task detection and parameter-efficient adaptation.
Moves beyond traditional methods that require explicit task boundaries, aiming for task-free scenarios.

stories.title: Show HN: We built open OpenRouter that turns usage into a better model
stories.author: SilenN
bullet_points: Introduction of an open-source model gateway designed to unify access to various LLMs (self-hosted, frontier, open-source).
The gateway is built in Rust, emphasizing concurrency and handling complex configuration quirks across different models and providers.
It boasts low latency (under 1-2ms for inference requests) and supports major inference providers.
